paragraphs.text: Thank you. Good evening, friends. Shall we bow our heads, just a moment, while we’re standing? Our Heavenly Father, we’re grateful to the Lord Jesus Christ for redeeming us from the life of sin, and permitting us to be called His children. I’m so thankful for the friends that You have given me, for these compliments that’s just been given to me by my brother and this audience. I’m unworthy of these blessings. But this: All glory to the Lord Jesus Christ, Who picked me up from a life of sin and saved me, for by His grace...and give me these friends. You did it, Lord, and I’m thankful for it. And may I always walk worthy, by Thy Spirit, of these, Thy children. May I be able to help them in some measure, Father, to show my appreciations of love that they have for me, and I for them. May that be granted tonight, Lord, by the preaching of the Word, or whatever You have us to do. Grant now that Your Holy Spirit will take charge of every heart in here, and help us, Lord, to receive Thy Word, and may the Spirit take the Word and give It to each one as we have need, for we ask it, in Jesus’ Name. Amen. May be seated. 1b Good evening, my beloved friends. I am unworthy of this compliment that Brother Joseph just gave me, and to you people, of your love, and pledge of loyalty, and so forth, but I certainly do appreciate this. God be with you is my prayer. I hope I never betray that feeling there is between us. I...as long as you feel that way about me, and I live right before God, we’ll always be a help one to another. No matter how many miracles our Lord Jesus would perform, how much He would vindicate It being truth, if you didn’t believe It and love me, there would be nothing I could do to help you. It’s just as you believe me, that’s how I could help you. 1c Mighty beloved place to be in, is Chicago. I was talking today to some friends and I told them that I believe if there was any city in the United States that I believe is ready for a—a real city-wide revival, is Chicago. That’s right. I believe it. I hear that the marvelous minister, Billy Graham, is coming in ’56, I believe it is. I pray that the revival will be on its road when he gets here. Just to...May he be able just to pick it up and go on with it, to a victory unto victory, until Jesus comes. You need a great, city-wide revival; seems like there’s an awful conviction hanging around the city at this time, especially amongst the people who love the Lord Jesus. And I’m so happy to be in your midst tonight, enjoying this wonderful fellowship. 1d Today I had to make a broadcast, or, I guess it’s to be broadcast pretty soon, some kind of recordings and so forth (For Sunday, I believe, Brother Joseph?) with my good friend, Brother Joseph and with Brother Ekberg. Say, I call him Joseph. That’s just...that’s one of his names, and I like the name of Joseph, it’s found...I—I like it. I love Brother— Brother Joseph with all my heart. I met my good friend, Brother Rasmussen, which is seated just behind me here, tonight, another one of your pastors here, was over in Tacoma, Washington, and we certainly had a—a time of fellowship together. 1e This morning, waking up...Last evening’s service was a great strain to me, it was the first for a few days, and it kind of laid me a little low this morning. There was...Sometimes people might not understand that, just why that that...I can’t explain it either, friends. I wish it didn’t, but it does. It makes me so weak I can hardly raise up. And I am not a weakling by a long ways, you know. But... [Brother Boze says, “You have a cot there.” Brother Branham and the congregation laugh—Ed.] Well, I hope I never have to use it though. [Brother Boze says, “The sister that lay on it, she is there too.”—Ed.] Brother Joseph said the one that was laying on it last night is setting in the audience tonight. What was wrong with the woman? Where...Is she here? [“Sister has testified; she’s right there.”] Well, that’s mighty fine. What was she...? [“She had been to the Mayo Brothers’ from the eighth to the sixteenth of December, then they sent her home with no, or very, very little hope. Nine doctors had examined her, could do nothing for her. And she came down here, her husband was unsaved. And she was carried in here in great pains. And I asked her how she slept last night. She didn’t sleep at all. She said she was too happy.”] Very fine. I am grateful for that. This...I haven’t picked up any of the recordings yet, cause it’s not been necessary. Someone suggest maybe, what was said to them, and maybe be questioned, then the—the records is given to me, of course. I have a copy of them, also. So when I come back over that, sister, I’ll rejoice with you. I am already, for whatever He said to you and whatever He did for you, I’m greatly appreciative. 1f Now, being I may stay a long time up at Chicago this time. I thought I would take it kind of easy to kind of, maybe, have some nights of speaking and altar calls, and see how many can receive the baptism of the Holy Spirit, and see how many can come to the Lord Jesus. And—and then have healing service now and then, just as the Holy Spirit will lead. So, I suppose maybe tonight, why, I’ll speak a little while, whatever the Holy Spirit leads. I don’t know even whether my boy, he come and got me a while ago, but I don’t know whether he give out any prayer cards. And we lost Brother Ekberg and we couldn’t find him in the lobby, and we...was supposed to be waiting for us and—and so I—I guess someone picked him up beforehand and took him. But, we’re happy, altogether, to be here. And talking of the sister being so happy she couldn’t sleep, well, that’s a good way to be, yes, sir. 1g How many knows F. F. Bosworth? All of you. By the way, he’s to be here in a few days, I believe. He’s just back from Japan; godly, saintly old brother. And he has always been a great blessing. I’ve had him with me, pretty near in all the meetings I’ve had. Now, as a teacher, he may not be able to preach like Paul, but he, like myself, he tries to catch the heart of the people. Maybe while someone’s giving a great forceful message, while someone is setting in the back of the room enjoying that. But this poor man laying here dying with a cancer, he don’t care about a forceful message. He wants to know some way out of the trouble he’s in, there. That’s the man Brother Bosworth talks to. So, I love him. And just to be around the old man, is just a blessing. I know he’s God servant, and I—I know that. And just to be around him, I just feel happy when he’s around. He’s just...I just take him along in the meeting; let him have an afternoon service and well, that’s it. We just have a...And now, as soon as I leave the platform, if anybody didn’t get prayed for, wants to be prayed for, Brother Bosworth’s in the harness to do it right then. And he gets wonderful results. Seventy-eight years old, just as young as he was when he was sixteen. He said, sister, to me, one time. I said, “Brother Bosworth, how is it that you come about, after you’re so old like this,” and I said, “how is it that you’re so, still so active?” He said, “You misunderstand, Brother Branham. I’m just a kid living in this old house,” he said. That’s a very good expression. And I was talking to him a few days ago, I said, “How are you, Brother Bosworth, after coming back from—from Japan, in that great crusade you had down there?” Said, “Brother Branham, that same old trouble come back to me again.” I said, “What trouble?” Said, “Just so happy I can’t sleep,” he said. So, you know, he’s a very fine old brother. So, I hope when you’re seventy-eight, you still having that trouble, can’t sleep from being so happy. May the Lord bless you, sister, and all the rest of you that’s been healed. 1h Billy, sometimes, and some of the other brethren, tries to quote to me, it seems to me like when you go talking about, I dream something, but I don’t remember just what it was. And it’s altogether a subconscious act. It’s, when man gets out of the way and God takes his place. That’s—that’s all. You know, God dwelt first in a Man called Jesus. And He, through the shedding of His Blood...See the first thing is a blood cell. That’s what we all come from. Inside of that blood cell is a life and that life is a spirit. And Almighty God went into the womb of this virgin and created around Himself a Blood Cell that brought forth the Son, Christ Jesus. At Calvary, that Blood Cell was bursted and become a Spray, and every man that’s borned again comes through this Spray into the Body of the Lord Jesus Christ, and we’re washed by the Blood and become a son of God, co-equal with Jesus, in the Kingdom. We’ll set with Him, someday, there, on the Throne. And said, “He that overcometh shall sit with Me on My throne, as I’ve overcome, and set on My Father’s throne.” What a glorious day that’ll be, when we shall see Him. 1k Now, tomorrow night, I believe is the winding up of the service in the tabernacle here. And then we go to the Lane Tech High School. I believe I understood Brother Joseph last night, when I was standing there at the door, to say there’d be an afternoon service; if the Lord willing, tomorrow night, I want to approach a subject on preaching, and also Sunday afternoon. 1m Now, testimonies is marvelous, aren’t they? Just as I was coming out of the study just a few moments ago, coming around the bend, a attractive young lady, standing in the room, and she said, “Don’t you remember me?” And of course, I’d been praying. I just kind of looked up. I said, “I...seems like I should know you.” She said, “I was the one in Hammond that was healed.” She was an alcoholic and she was healed. 1n She was called out, the best I remember of the girl’s testimony, she was setting up in the balcony somewhere. And there was a woman on the platform, which was a famous dancer, a dancer to Fred Astaire. And she had went away from God, and she’d married a Catholic fellow and her home had broke up. She had a little boy by him. And, oh, she’s become a dope addict or something. And I know first it was resented, but the Holy Spirit is always right, and it was correctly. And then, also, I believe it’s the same night, the Holy Spirit reached way up in the balcony, at Hammond, Indiana, and told this girl that she was an alcoholic. The best to my memory that’s the way it was on the tape, I believe. And tonight, she went out that way; she probably is in the building somewhere now, probably listening to me. But, she had a lovely testimony and all along we hear from her through the office and so forth. She writes letters and send in some tithings once in a while and things like that, very lovely person. 1p Then reading the mail this morning, many of you writing letters, I just want to read something here just before we open the Word of God, and show you a picture. The person, perhaps, is here. I will not read all the letter because...just what it pertains to the testimony, ’cause part of it might be that something the person said in the letter here, wanted me to pray for somebody, that they might not want it told. This is January the twelfth. 1q “Dear Brother Branham: Greeting in the Name of our wonderful Lord. When you were here in Chicago, your last revival, I brought a cloth, you prayed over it, for my granddaughter, who was a cerebral palsy case, as I could not get her mother and daddy to church. She, her mother, is an unsaved Catholic; her father, unsaved also. This baby was five months old, had spent most of its time in the hospital. But finally I convinced them to put the cloth you had prayed over on the baby. And God almost instantly healed it. She has never been about a hospital since, and is now a lovely healthy baby.” 1r She sends a picture of the little tyke. Out of thousands...that was here in Chicago, out of thousands of testimonies the world around... You know, friend, if I had to stand the critics of the world, with all the criticism the world says about Divine healing, if nowhere in my ministry, in these twenty-three years on the field, and these eight years in the revival healing campaign, if nothing had happened but this alone, it would doubly pay me. Someone’s happy. A little baby’s life, who a doctor could not save, nothing could be done (You know what cerebral palsy—palsy is. It’s gone unless God helps, you know.), and she was instantly healed by the power of Almighty God, by placing on her a handkerchief. I’m so thankful. Lady, if you’re here, God bless you, the grandmother of the child. I trust that the little baby will always be well, and will come a great servant of God. Thank you for your little contribution that was in there. 1s And also, here’s a letter, here. I won’t take time to read it, just quote it to you, is a testimony. I just picked these up as I was coming from the room. The young lady who came to the Benton Harbor, Michigan, I believe, meeting, or somewhere up above here, and she was born here in Chicago...[Blank spot on tape—Ed.]...?... 1t Well, what do you know, just about—about two dozen never been in one of the campaigns before. We certainly welcome you, our beloved friends, and love with the Lord Jesus. May His Spirit stir you tonight and your emotions greatly to love Him more and more. Now, This is always, fundamentally, the correct Word of God, the Bible, every bit of It inspired. And It’s all God’s Word, and God is in His Word. So if God is in His Word, then if you receive the Word, you receive God. Now that is God’s plan, God’s motive, God’s attitude, God’s love, God’s salvation. Everything rests in His printed Word. And if those Words are just like grains, or seed that you could pick out and swallow, every one of them would produce just exactly what it says it’ll do here. But by faith we receive them

paragraphs.text: Now, someone asked me some time ago, said, “Brother Branham, when those visions come, what is that part of God?” I said, “That’s secondarily God’s Word. If that would say something that wasn’t according to this Bible, then it would absolutely be wrong. This is first.” And now, this is God. He said, “I’m the Lord that healeth thee.” All the healing then comes from God. He’s the One does the healing. All the Divine promises come from God, ’cause it’s His Word to you and to me.

paragraphs.text: Right along, towards the last of His ministry in the 15th chapter of Saint John, I believe it is, he said, “No...Now You speak plainly and not by parables.
